def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v0` with saturation voltage incorporation."""
    
    Vt = parameters[0]
    Kp = parameters[1]
    Lambda = parameters[2]
    
    VGS_sat = parameters[3]
    VDS_sat = parameters[4]
    
    I_sat = Kp * (gate_voltage_abs - Vt) ** 2
    gm = I_sat / VDS_sat
    
    indSat = (gate_voltage_abs > VGS_sat) & (drain_voltage_abs > VDS_sat)
    
    ID, ind = np.filter(gate_voltage_abs, indSat) * np.filter(drain_voltage_abs, indSat)
    
    ID_log = np.log10(ID / I_sat)
    
    y = parameters[5] + parameters[6] * gate_voltage_abs + parameters[7] * drain_voltage_abs
    
    return (ID_log if np.abs((gate_voltage_abs - VGS_sat) / VGS_sat) > 1.0 and np.abs((drain_voltage_abs - VDS_sat) / VDS_sat) > 1.0
            else y)
